## Email Draft Responder

Webhook-driven mock draft generator for the Agent Operations Portal demo.

Contract:
- Inbound: spec §12.1 (execution_id, callback{url,secret}, input.items[])
- Callback: spec §12.2 (status, metrics, result)
- Result schema: spec §14.2 (drafts[].subject|body|approval_status)

Demo rule (CRITICAL):
Never send emails. Every draft is created with approval_status='waiting_for_review'.
Backend approval endpoint flips that flag — no SMTP involved.
